en: The postcard depicts a grand neoclassical building set at the end of a palm-tree-lined walkway. The façade is adorned with columns and ornate architectural details, creating an impression of a monumental public building or palace. At the top center of the building, above the entrance, the words 'PALACE CASINO' are visible, suggesting its original function. The image is colorized in a manner characteristic of early to mid-20th-century postcards. There are a few people walking towards the entrance, dressed in old-fashioned attire.
